entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. Can I have your name and order number, please?
Hi Alex, my name is Jordan Riley, and the order number is VF-881-2945.
Thank you, Jordan. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the AeroPro Helmet in Velocity Red. How can I help you today?
Yes, that's the one. I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's just a preference thing. The online picture made the color look like a brighter red, but in person, it's more of a crimson and clashes with my bike frame. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.
I understand. Getting the gear to match perfectly is definitely part of the fun. Let me just check the delivery date here... okay, I see it was delivered 40 days ago.
No problem at all. For a standard item like this helmet, you're well within our 90-day return window. I can approve this return for you right now and get a label sent over.

Excellent, thank you. Now, I do plan on ordering another helmet from you in a different color. Since I'm a repeat customer and this return is for a simple color swap, would you be able to offer a small discount or maybe waive the return shipping fee?

I appreciate you asking, and we're happy you're choosing VeloFit for your next helmet. Our main priority is your satisfaction and safety. However, our policy is quite strict about goodwill credits for preference-based returns. The generous 90-day window is the main accommodation we provide for situations like this. I am unable to add a discount code.
I understand the policy, but a little something would ensure I place the next order today. Are you sure there's nothing you can do, even just covering the return postage?

I have already approved the full refund for the product, which is the best I can do according to policy. I can generate the return shipping label for you, and the standard shipping fee will just be deducted from the refund total once we receive the item. That's the most straightforward way to handle it.
Okay, that's fair enough. As long as the process is simple, I'm happy. Please send over the label.

Of course. I've just sent the return authorization and the shipping label to the email on file. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the unopened helmet, you'll see the refund in 3 to 5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're welcome, Jordan. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
